project: BattleTanx: Global Assault native PC port
approach: Static recompilation with native platform services, RT64 rendering, and SDL2 audio and input.
notes: The native Windows runtime reaches the original menus and campaign gameplay with rendering, audio, keyboard, and controller support. Linux has a native Vulkan build path. Multiplayer, broad hardware coverage, long-session stability, and complete game-mode validation remain in development.
